question: Should the trusted release publisher require successful immutable ledger validation before any publication, or is an operator-enforced hold intentionally sufficient?
rationale: The code can mechanically enforce the ledger, but only release owners can accept or reject a publication process that remains manually guarded and technically bypassable.

options.title: Enforce validation before publish
options.body: Add required ledger run and artifact inputs to the trusted publisher and block every publication path when validation fails or evidence is absent.

options.title: Accept manual enforcement
options.body: Keep the standalone validator and explicitly accept that release operators, rather than repository automation, must prevent evidence bypass.

recommendation.title: Enforce validation before publish
recommendation.body: Add required ledger run and artifact inputs to the trusted publisher and block every publication path when validation fails or evidence is absent.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant history shows ownership of the trusted publication workflow and its immutable validation-evidence contract.
